How to play

Hold to charge; release for a spin.Selected itemK / X · gamepad XLift / throw / useE / Space · gamepad BChoose itemQ / R or 1–7 · shoulder buttonsItems / mapTab / M · gamepad Y / SelectPauseEsc / P · gamepad StartShieldAutomatically blocks small incoming projectiles when facing them, unless attacking or carrying.

Explore, observe, experiment

Lift pots to uncover switches. Throw them at enemies. Walk into marked blocks to push them. A sleeping eye is armored; wait until it opens. The map reveals rooms, the compass marks treasures.

Touch: drag on the left side or use the D-pad. The three right buttons act, use an item and swing the sword. “Next item” cycles tools. Menus support directional keys and Enter, or gamepad.
